  SELECT order_id FROM orders
  WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-04-01' AND order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-07-01'
), agg AS (
  SELECT
    (SELECT count(*) FROM q2) AS orders,
    (SELECT count(DISTINCT q.order_id) FROM q2 q JOIN order_reviews r ON r.order_id = q.order_id) AS reviewed_orders,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM q2 q JOIN order_reviews r ON r.order_id = q.order_id) AS review_rows
)
SELECT orders, reviewed_orders, review_rows,
  review_rows - reviewed_orders AS overcount_abs,
  round(100.0 * (review_rows - reviewed_orders) / reviewed_orders, 4) AS overcount_pct,
  round(100.0 * reviewed_orders / orders, 4) AS reviewed_rate_pct,
  round(100.0 * review_rows / orders, 4) AS review_rows_rate_pct
FROM agg"}

2018 年 Q2（按 order_purchase_timestamp 落在 2018-04-01 至 2018-06-30 之间，含全部订单状态）：

用评价记录数当已评价订单数会怎样：
- 会高估 26 单（review_rows − reviewed_orders = 26），相对已评价订单数高估 0.1309%。原因是部分订单存在多条评价记录（一单多评），评价行数不能等同于订单数。
- 评价覆盖率会被轻微抬高：真实口径 reviewed_orders/orders = 99.4194%，若误用 review_rows/orders 则为 99.5495%，虚高约 0.13 个百分点。
- 结论：Q2 期间一单多评的比例很小，两种口径差异有限，但口径本身错误；做评价覆盖率、评价率等指标时应使用按订单去重的 EXISTS/DISTINCT 口径，评价行数只用于评价内容/评分分布类分析。
